mitigations.title: Emergency Security Patching for CVE-2021-44228
mitigations.description: Upgrade affected software packages and dependencies to remediate CVE-2021-44228.
actionable_steps: Identify all production hosts and containers executing the vulnerable dependency.
Deploy vendor updated packages or library versions in staging.
Apply emergency production deployment following change management protocol.

mitigations.title: WAF Virtual Patching & Egress Boundary Filtering
mitigations.description: Deploy edge inspection signatures and restrict unexpected outbound protocols.
actionable_steps: Configure WAF rules to block malicious exploit payloads in HTTP headers and request bodies.
Block outbound server egress on non-standard ports (e.g. LDAP 389/636, RMI 1099).
